## Post-freeze amendments

- A1: the Physion testing HDF5s store 512 x 512 frames (dynamics and readout: 256 x 256); the frozen definition is a 256 x 256 parser input, but physion_trial passed the stored frames through, so the parser raised on the first testing trial (typed shape error, all four parse workers). Fix: testing frames are resized to 256 x 256 with the PIL box filter, and the segmentation presence threshold (16 pixels at 256 x 256) is scaled to the stored area; testing labels are re-derived. The runner gains the amendment registry (load_plan accepts module hashes chained from the frozen ones) and lists amendments in summary.json. CLEVRER parse outputs written before the failure are kept.
- A2: EXPLORATORY readout mode `explore` added (post-hoc, no disposition): the frozen CLEVRER QA readout sat at its floor (max gated micro contact value 0.051 < threshold 0.5 on every validation video; parsed max-over-frames existence admits 362 phantom objects vs 1911 real in 400 videos, so 38 % of choices are unresolvable), giving identical decisions for every arm; the Physion predicate rule likewise never fired. The exploratory readout uses a 5-frame existence rule and thresholds fitted on the training (CLEVRER) / readout (Physion) split. slot_attributes gains min_frames (default 1 = frozen behaviour); findings.md gains label-free tables, parser fidelity and the exploratory section.

Compute: 12010 GPU s; engine seconds 0.
